privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Hearthline is a hackathon demo: the town, the people and the payments are fictional, and payments run in PayPal's sandbox, so no real money moves. This page says what the app keeps about you and why.

sections.p: Your household's details (address, household size, damage), the photos you add and the inventory made from them, your registry, and every payment, in a double-entry ledger. Reviewers' decisions and other important actions go in a tamper-evident audit log.

If you connect your PayPal account with Log in with PayPal, we keep its PayPal account ID, email, name and whether PayPal has verified it, so we can send your money there. We don't keep PayPal's sign-in tokens. PayPal handles the payments themselves; we never see card or bank details.

Photos and text you add are sent to an AI service (Google Gemini, or OpenRouter as a backup) to list items, check photos and draft notes. Item names go to Channel3 to find prices. A person reviews before any claim-related money moves.

Donors see a registry's story and items, never your address. Reviewers and relief staff see what they need to decide a case. PayPal addresses are masked in logs and on screens that don't need the full address.
You can change the PayPal account your money goes to at any time. In a real deployment you could ask to see or delete your data; in this demo, the data is reset regularly.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: Hearthline is a hackathon demo, offered as is. Its code is open source under the MIT license.

sections.p: Payments run in PayPal's sandbox with test accounts. Nothing you do here charges or pays anyone.
The Policy agent, price checks and reports help you understand your situation. They are not legal, insurance or tax advice.
AI prepares evidence and drafts. People approve cash aid, claims, refunds and answers to payment disputes, and every decision is logged.
Don't use Hearthline to impersonate anyone or to move money that isn't yours. Registries that copy a real family are rejected and their gifts refunded.
AG Grid, Bryntum, Channel3, APIMatic, Render and PayPal are used under their own terms.
The software is provided without warranty, as the MIT license says.

disasters.title: Disasters
disasters.subtitle: Open a real disaster in Hearthline from FEMA's declarations or the National Weather Service's warnings. Its counties (or the warning's own outline) become the zone: households whose address is inside join it, and first-72-hours aid is proposed for the ones that prepared. The demo stays the fictional Sablewood Fire.

verify_address.title: Confirm your home address
verify_address.detail: Hearthline checks it against the disaster area before aid can reach you.

confirm_residence.title: Show you live there
confirm_residence.detail: Upload a bill or lease, or ask a caseworker to vouch for you if your papers burned.

connect_paypal.title: Connect your PayPal account
connect_paypal.detail: Cash aid and insurance payments go straight to it.

case_needs_info.title: A reviewer needs something from you

approve_purchase.title: Approve a purchase
approve_purchase.detail: The Shopper wants to buy {{title}} for {{total}}. It waits for your OK.

approve_milestone.title: Approve a rebuild step
approve_milestone.detail: {{title}} ({{amount}}): look at the contractor's photos, then approve or ask for changes.

fema_apply.title: Apply for FEMA disaster assistance
fema_apply.detail: If FEMA declared a major disaster for your county, apply within 60 days of the declaration at DisasterAssistance.gov. Your Hearthline inventory and policy help.

upload_policy.title: Upload your insurance policy
upload_policy.detail: Hearthline reads its limits and deadlines, so nothing is missed.

prepare_claim.title: Send your contents claim
prepare_claim.detail: Built from your inventory, with your policy's limits applied. Your adjuster can pay it with PayPal.

ca_advance.title: Ask for California's advance payments
ca_advance.detail: After a total loss in a declared emergency, California requires insurers to offer advance payments for living expenses and belongings. Ask your adjuster.

list_needs.title: List what your family needs
list_needs.detail: Donors fund specific things on your Rebuild Registry.

crew_visit.title: Crew visit: {{title}}
crew_visit.detail: A relief crew is coming to your address.

video_call.title: Video call with a reviewer
video_call.detail: About your case. Have your ID nearby.

dispatch.title: Dispatch agent
dispatch.intro: Tell the agent what matters; it plans tomorrow's visits for every job that has no crew yet: the most urgent first, nearby stops together, within each crew's free hours. Code works out every time and every drive, and nothing moves until you accept.
dispatch.instructionsPlaceholder: Optional, e.g. Medical needs first. Give Van 2 both Mesa Dr stops.
